content.description: Illustration showing installation of two valve body covers on the upper portion of the valve body assembly

content.text: Use the wave washer for the smaller cover.

content.description: Illustration showing valve body assembly with retainers and locating pins visible in the internal passages

content.heading: CHECK RETAINERS AND LOCATING PINS
content.text: Make sure that the retainers and pins are installed correctly.

content.description: Illustration showing installation locations of springs, damping check ball, cooler return check ball, and cooler by-pass check valve in the valve body

content.heading: INSTALL SPRINGS, DAMPING CHECK BALL, COOLER RETURN CHECK BALL AND COOLER BY-PASS CHECK VALVE

content.description: Illustration showing the two lower valve body gaskets laid out separately, indicating they are not interchangeable

content.heading: INSTALL LOWER VALVE BODY GASKET
content.text: Note that the two gaskets are not interchangeable. The gasket must lay flat on the valve body.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of the lower valve body plate onto the valve body assembly

content.heading: INSTALL LOWER VALVE BODY PLATE
content.text: Set the plate into place. Temporarily install two the short bolts finger tight to compress the plate against the spring-loaded check valve.
